changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Gold layer views on dim/fact — configurable, no extra storage
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_equity_ohlcv AS SELECT d.symbol, d.asset_class, f.* FROM fact.fact_market_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument d USING(instrument_id)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_yahoo_summary AS SELECT symbol, count(*) bars, avg(close) avg_close FROM fact.fact_market_ohlcv JOIN dim.dim_instrument USING(instrument_id) GROUP BY symbol

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_gold.vw_macro_yoy AS SELECT indicator_id, country_iso3, date, value, lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY indicator_id, country_iso3 ORDER BY date) AS prev FROM fact.fact_macro_observations
